title: Report on the Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with UAP, Volume I (AARO, Feb 2024)
doc_notes: This document is the AARO Historical Record Report Volume I, which reviews USG involvement with UAP since 1945 and investigates interviewee claims of hidden programs.

incidents.summary: Kenneth Arnold sighting of nine circular objects near Mount Rainier, Washington.
Alleged recovery of metallic and rubber debris from a crashed military balloon near Roswell, New Mexico.
incidents.explanation: Materials were consistent with a balloon used in the then-classified Project Mogul.
incidents.quote: The materials recovered near Roswell were consistent with a balloon of the type used in the then-classified Project Mogul.

incidents.summary: Interviewee claimed to have touched an extraterrestrial spacecraft in a building.
incidents.explanation: Interviewee likely touched an F-117 Nighthawk stealth fighter.
incidents.quote: The interviewee stated that the senior officer gave a detailed description of a craft floating in a building.

incidents.summary: Interviewee overheard conversation about aliens present during specialized materials testing.
incidents.explanation: Likely a misunderstanding of a test and evaluation unit with a nickname with alien connotations.
incidents.quote: The interviewee also reported that on another occasion in the 1990s he observed an “unidentified flying object” at a U.S. military facility.

incidents.summary: Interviewee encountered U.S. Special Forces loading containers onto a large extraterrestrial spacecraft.
incidents.quote: encountered “U.S. Special Forces” loading containers onto a large extraterrestrial spacecraft.

incidents.summary: Observation of a UAP destroying an ICBM loaded with a dummy warhead mid-flight.
incidents.explanation: Correlated with an antiballistic missile test.
incidents.quote: AARO was able to correlate the general time and location with an antiballistic missile test
